parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this policer.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of this policer. {{enum}} The {{enum|Error}} value MAY be used by the CPE to indicate a locally defined error condition.

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.description: {{datatype|expand}}

parameters.name: CommittedRate
parameters.description: Committed rate allowed for this policer in {{units}}. Note: To be able to support higher bit rates, this parameter was changed to unsignedLong in the Device:2.18 version.

parameters.name: CommittedBurstSize
parameters.description: Committed Burstsize in {{units}}.

parameters.name: ExcessBurstSize
parameters.description: Excess Burstsize in {{units}}. Applied for a {{enum|SingleRateThreeColor|MeterType}} meter.

parameters.name: PeakRate
parameters.description: Peak rate allowed for this Meter in {{units}}. Applied for {{enum|TwoRateThreeColor|MeterType}} meters. Note: To be able to support higher bit rates, this parameter was changed to unsignedLong in the Device:2.18 version.

parameters.name: PeakBurstSize
parameters.description: Peak Burstsize in {{units}}. Applied for {{enum|TwoRateThreeColor|MeterType}} meters.

parameters.name: MeterType
parameters.description: Identifies the method of traffic measurement to be used for this policer. {{enum|SimpleTokenBucket}} makes use of {{param|CommittedRate}} and {{param|CommittedBurstSize}}. {{enum|SingleRateThreeColor}} makes use of {{param|CommittedRate}}, {{param|CommittedBurstSize}}, and {{param|ExcessBurstSize}} as defined in {{bibref|RFC2697}}. {{enum|TwoRateThreeColor}} makes use of {{param|CommittedRate}}, {{param|CommittedBurstSize}}, {{param|PeakRate}}, and {{param|PeakBurstSize}} as defined in {{bibref|RFC2698}}.

parameters.name: PossibleMeterTypes
parameters.description: {{list}} Indicates supported meter types.

parameters.name: ConformingAction
parameters.description: Instructions for how to handle traffic that is conforming. {{pattern}} {{pattern|Null}} corresponds with no action. ''<DSCP Value>'' is an unsigned integer that corresponds with a mark action overwriting the traffic's DSCP with the configured DSCP. ''<:Ethernet Priority>'' is a colon (":") followed by an unsigned integer (no white space). It corresponds with a mark action overwriting the traffic's Ethernet Priority with the configured Ethernet Priority. ''<DSCP Value:Ethernet Priority>'' is an unsigned integer followed by a colon (":") and a second unsigned integer (no white space). It corresponds with a mark action overwriting the traffic's DSCP and Ethernet Priority with the configured values. For example, "24" specifies a DSCP value of 24, ":3" specifies an Ethernet Priority of 3, and "24:3" specifies both.

parameters.name: PartialConformingAction
parameters.description: Instructions for how to handle traffic that is partially conforming (colored yellow). {{pattern}} {{pattern|Null}} corresponds with no action. ''<DSCP Value>'' is an unsigned integer that corresponds with a mark action overwriting the traffic's DSCP with the configured DSCP.Only applies for three-color meters. ''<:Ethernet Priority>'' is a colon (":") followed by an unsigned integer (no white space). It corresponds with a mark action overwriting the traffic's Ethernet Priority with the configured Ethernet Priority. ''<DSCP Value:Ethernet Priority>'' is an unsigned integer followed by a colon (":") and a second unsigned integer (no white space). It corresponds with a mark action overwriting the traffic's DSCP and Ethernet Priority with the configured values. For example, "24" specifies a DSCP value of 24, ":3" specifies an Ethernet Priority of 3, and "24:3" specifies both.

parameters.name: NonConformingAction

''<DSCP Value>'' is an unsigned integer that corresponds with a mark action overwriting the traffic's DSCP with the configured DSCP. ''<:Ethernet Priority>'' is a colon (":") followed by an unsigned integer (no white space). It corresponds with a mark action overwriting the traffic's Ethernet Priority with the configured Ethernet Priority. ''<DSCP Value:Ethernet Priority>'' is an unsigned integer followed by a colon (":") and a second unsigned integer (no white space). It corresponds with a mark action overwriting the traffic's DSCP and Ethernet Priority with the configured values. For example, "24" specifies a DSCP value of 24, ":3" specifies an Ethernet Priority of 3, and "24:3" specifies both.
